title: Can two switches do arithmetic?
hook: Can you wire two gates so that they add 1 + 1 correctly?

doesNotKnow: the gates AND, OR and XOR
that a sum digit and a carry digit are each one gate

misconception: A computer has to "know" arithmetic; it cannot be wires and switches.
objective: The learner can build and explain a half adder: sum = A XOR B and carry = A AND B, so 1 + 1 gives carry 1, sum 0 (binary 10).

claims.text: 1 + 1 = 2, which is 10 in binary: carry 1, sum 0; in binary counting goes 0, 1, 10, 11.
claims.source: Binary place value; Demo.tsx rightOn() checks (carry, sum) against floor((a+b)/2) and (a+b) mod 2. | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-14 (pass 12): node: (2).toString(2) = '10'; 0,1,2,3 = 0,1,10,11; rightOn() compares carry with floor((a+b)/2) and sum with (a+b) mod 2.

claims.text: XOR outputs 1 when exactly one input is 1; AND outputs 1 only when both inputs are 1; OR outputs 1 when at least one is 1; the stage shows the rule for each chosen gate.
claims.source: Truth tables (definition). Patterson and Hennessy, Computer Organization and Design, Appendix B (A.2 in some editions) 'Gates, Truth Tables, and Logic Equations'. | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-14 (pass 12): Truth tables: XOR = a^b, AND = a&b, OR = a|b (apply() in Demo.tsx); RULE text shown for the selected sum and carry gates ('OR: 1 if either is 1' = at least one).

claims.text: Sum = A XOR B and carry = A AND B add two bits correctly on all four inputs; this pair of gates is called a half adder. No other choice of AND, OR, XOR for the two slots gets all four.
claims.source: Demo.tsx rightOn(sum, carry) over the 9 gate pairs: only (XOR, AND) scores 4 of 4 (builder enumerated in Node). Patterson and Hennessy, Appendix B, adders. · Fact-check 2026-10-13: Enumerated all 9 gate pairs: only (XOR, AND) scores 4.

recall.question: In a half adder, which gate produces the carry digit?
options: AND, because the carry is 1 only when both bits are 1
XOR, because the carry is 1 when the bits differ
OR, because the carry is 1 when either bit is 1
recall.why: A carry happens only for 1 + 1, the one case where both inputs are 1: that is AND. XOR gives the sum digit.
